extraction.name: Fully Authentic Visual Question Answering Dataset
extraction.description: A VQA dataset sourced from online question answering community forums
extraction.creator: Chongyan Chen, Mengchen Liu, Noel Codella, Yunsheng Li, Lu Yuan, Danna Gurari
extraction.publisher: University of Texas at Austin, Microsoft, University of Colorado Boulder
extraction.citeAs: Chen, C., Liu, M., et al. (2024). Fully Authentic Visual Question Answering Dataset from Online Communities.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by scraping data from the online question-answering platform Stack Exchange, which spanned from August 2010 to November 2022, and adhered to all data license restrictions (cc-by-sa 4.0) set forth by Stack Exchange.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Two filtering steps were conducted to obtain the final dataset of 64,696 VQAs. First, visual questions with scores 0 or less for either the question or answer were removed. Second, visual questions with multiple images or with visual answers were excluded.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Removed low-quality VQAs based on Stack Exchange’s feature that enables users to up-vote or down-vote each post. Removed visual questions with multiple images or with visual answers. Images were converted to png format for data format consistency.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: The mean number of answers per visual question is 1.45.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is publicly shared at https://vqaonline.github.io/
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Improved models designed for VQAonline can also benefit many other real-world applications including for other community question answering platforms, learning assistance VQA tools for children, virtual assistants, visual dialog and query, as well as visual search and browsing.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may poorly represent people in poverty-stricken areas since VQAs are posted by Stack Exchange users with access to mobile devices and Internet. The geographic representation of Stack Exchange is unbalanced, with more from countries like US, India, Europe and less from countries like Egypt.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning. Usage Guidelines: https://vqaonline.github.io/
